stories.title: Met Office forecast points to heatwave for Flintshire
stories.summary: Temperatures in Deeside are set to climb through the weekend and into next week, reaching a forecast 27°C on Monday. stories.title: HyNet pipeline works bring increased traffic to Northop Hall as project team holds Ewloe drop-in tonight
stories.summary: The HyNet carbon capture pipeline team will be in Ewloe this evening for a public drop-in, as site preparation work gets under way at Northop Hall for one of the key installations on the route through Flintshire. stories.title: Flintshire confirmed for new Youth Hub in UK Government rollout
stories.summary: Flintshire has been confirmed as the site of a new Youth Hub offering employment, skills and wellbeing support to people aged 16 to 24. stories.title: Senedd told case for devolving policing to Wales has “never been stronger”
